fallbackPlan: Do not claim final 5/5 Well-Architected scores until every question row has owner-backed evidence, freshness, validation, and fallback coverage.

scoreScale.1: No meaningful repository or account evidence.
scoreScale.2: Planning evidence exists, but implementation or operating evidence is missing.
scoreScale.3: Partial repository controls exist, but owner, cadence, validation, or fallback evidence is incomplete.
scoreScale.4: Strong repository or AWS metadata evidence exists, but at least one external, owner, freshness, or drill requirement blocks 5/5.
scoreScale.5: All target evidence, ownership, freshness, validation, and fallback requirements are current.
